features.catalog_choice: yes (flat list, product and channel in each row, search)
features.default_selection: branding `default_image`, then catalog `default_image`; else you must pick
features.connectivity_check: own network screen when the install needs a download, not for a copy of this computer's system; probes the image's registry first; Network settings and Recheck buttons
features.recovery_key: own recovery-key screen: key label, Copy, QR dialog, acknowledgement gating Done
features.hostname: field, first value from the image
features.account_groups: wheel, sudo and developer groups, operator override
features.locale_pages: language, keyboard (XKB layout, with a test field) and time zone pickers as own screens; nothing is picked until the person picks; listed on confirm; live-applied best-effort; checked by fisherman validate
features.try_or_install: yes: Try PRODUCT quits to the live session; Next installs
features.network_page: own screen when the install needs a download; skipped on offline media and copies; Network settings and Recheck
features.prerelease_page: shown for RELEASE_TYPE pre-release or experiment
features.eula_page: shown when the image ships an agreement; the accept box gates Next
features.rst_page: warns and continues when Intel RST hides disks
features.wipe_or_free: daemon backend: free-space install or whole-disk erase; forced erase counts three seconds down on confirm
features.recovery_key_screen: own screen with key label, Copy, QR dialog and acknowledgement gating Done; no key never advances
features.handoff_page: Continue hands over (daemon), Not now skips to done
features.done_try_again: failed and cancelled installs offer Try again (back to confirm); installed offers Not now
features.cancel_install: Cancel button and window close: each asks first; a cancelled page follows
features.translatable: gettext, one domain (`tuna-installer-xfce`), lint test; template `po/tuna-installer-xfce.pot`; the Flatpak compiles `po/fr.po` to a `.mo`, loaded for the locale; catalogs kept current by a check; branding copy stays in one language (#311)
features.source_check: confirm page, under the summary; a blocked source holds Next
features.install_plan: yes: the target disk (model, size, serial; unknown when the disk does not report it) and each device erased, under the summary; Next binds the recipe to that disk with `diskIdentity`; without a plan (an older fisherman, a timeout) the page is as before
features.bootc_store_view: yes, on the confirm page; the system that this computer runs is a second install source there (experimental, never the default, never on live media)
features.source_reuse_progress: yes: a label under the bar; the bar holds until the first step; the cancel dialog says that the disk does not change
features.done_receipt: yes: install ID and first-boot check, or the reason
features.log_after_failure: log tail; the failure page says whether the disk was changed, and when the cleanup failed or timed out
features.recovery_key_not_in_log: yes (install.log, log pane and failure tail redacted)
